name: @local/intelligent-inspiration
author: intelligent-inspiration contributors
description: Turns cards, actions, inspiration, quiz, sort, softmax, match, and chart fences in a chat answer into interactive blocks instead of code: a resource list with linked titles, a checkable list of next steps, full-width suggested next prompts that fill the composer, a graded quiz with explanations, an order-the-steps exercise, a temperature slider driving live probability bars, a pair-the-columns exercise, and a small bar or line chart. The host half teaches the Claim → Quiz → What to do → Recommendations format, with the quiz checking whether the reader understood the claim.
